From long videos to scroll-stopping shorts

Just 3 simple steps. Turn any long video into viral clips in minutes.

1ImportDrop a long video — a podcast, interview, stream or talk.

2DiscoverClippo transcribes the speech and finds the moments that stand on their own.

Questions, answered

What is Clippo?

Clippo is an online tool that turns one long video, like a podcast, interview, stream or class, into short vertical 9:16 clips for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok, with captions, reframing, zooms, B-roll and music.

How does Clippo pick the clips?

It transcribes the speech, then scores every possible moment on its hook, whether it is a complete thought, its energy and its ending. Repeats and weak moments are dropped, and the rest are ranked best first.

Do my videos get uploaded?

No. Clippo runs inside your browser and processes the video on your own computer. Your files are never uploaded to our servers.

Is Clippo free?

Your first video is free, with every feature and a small Clippo watermark. For more videos and no watermark, buy a Pro pass: ₹99 for a day, ₹199 for a week, ₹399 for 30 days or ₹1,299 for a year.

Does a pass renew automatically?

No. Every pass is a one-time payment through Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets). It simply ends unless you buy another.

Can I edit the clips?

Yes. Open any clip to change the captions, start and end, framing, zoom, B-roll, music and sound effects. Your edits are kept.

Which languages work?

English and Hindi work best, and captions can be written in Hinglish. Other languages can work but may be less accurate.

What do I need to use it?

A laptop or PC with Chrome or Edge. Phones can open Clippo, but long videos need a computer.

What quality are the exports?

Clips export as 1080×1920 MP4 files, ready for Reels, Shorts and TikTok.
